subject.title: [优化建议] 添加结构化错误处理和智能重试机制

question: Which npm install failures should OpenClaw auto-retry or auto-repair, and which should only print guided recovery steps across Bash, PowerShell, and Docker setup paths?
rationale: The source proves a real installer diagnostics gap, but retry budgets, macOS/Windows EACCES repair, npm prefix mutation, TLS/security-adjacent failures, and optional setup-probe strictness change existing install behavior and need maintainer intent.

options.title: Define narrow policy, then implement
options.body: Retry only classified transient network failures and add platform-specific EACCES, ENOSPC, E404, EBADENGINE, and TLS guidance or repair with focused Bash and PowerShell tests.

options.title: Guidance-only diagnostics
options.body: Keep install side effects mostly unchanged but improve messages and docs links for permission, disk, engine, package, TLS, and network failures.

options.title: Keep partial diagnostics
options.body: Accept the current npm code/syscall/errno output plus targeted cleanup retries without broader structured installer policy.

recommendation.title: Define narrow policy, then implement
recommendation.body: Retry only classified transient network failures and add platform-specific EACCES, ENOSPC, E404, EBADENGINE, and TLS guidance or repair with focused Bash and PowerShell tests.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent cross-platform installer history across the Bash, PowerShell, and Docker setup files involved in the policy choice.
